blocks.html: In short, יהוה revealed Himself in a man of His providing who became the pattern for all those who would approach unto Him in hope of eternal life. יהוה does not expect that such will attain unto the perfection they behold in the Son, but He does require of them that they build into their lives some of the divine characteristics that they see there revealed. By so doing, they develop a character worthy of perpetuation in a body of incorruptible glory in the Age to come (Qorintiyim Aleph/1 Cor. 15:53-57).

blocks.html: The word translated from in Tehillim/Psalm 22:10, means beginning at, starting with. Yahushua is prophetically pictured through King David to say that יהוה was His strength from the beginning, starting with the point Yahushua Messiah was conceived in His mother's womb. יהוה was Yahushua's strength. This can only mean one thing: that before Yahushua was in His mother's womb, יהוה was not His strength, because Yahushua did not yet exist. He had no need of strength. יהוה was only Yahushua's strength, beginning at, starting with, His mother's womb. The belief that Yahushua had his beginning in the womb as flesh is The Spirit of יהוה. The denial and belief in the incarnation and Trinity is the Spirit of the False Messiah (Yahushua Messiah).
